title:
Transform to define the overall time window, compatible with both bulk and single asset dataset preparation.
Expects an object `params` as input with the following properties:
- `isBulk`
- `windowStart`
- `windowEnd`
- `interval`
- `windowStartBulk`
- `windowEndBulk`
- `intervalBulk`
Returns `windowStart`, `windowEnd` and `interval` based on the value of `isBulk`
name: DatasetPreparationTimeWindowTransform
